title: Electoral votes per US state (Data panel), 2024, 2028 and 2032 elections
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census apportionment of the U.S. House of Representatives
note: Bundled with the editor, not fetched. A state's electors are its seats in the House plus its two senators; the District of Columbia has 3 (23rd Amendment). Maine and Nebraska split their votes by congressional district; the map shows each state's total.
credit: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census apportionment; electors = House seats + 2 (the District of Columbia has 3). Public domain.
